name: Khoai tay dai
summary: Khoai tây dài phủ sốt is long fried potato sticks under a thick sauce, usually mayonnaise, cheese, or chili. The potato is crisp and the sauce rich.
taste: The potato is crisp and the sauce rich, usually mayonnaise, cheese, or chili sauce.
seoTitle: Khoai tay dai — sauced potato sticks in Vung Tau
seoDescription: Long fried potato sticks under mayonnaise, cheese, or chili sauce, at 17 Trưng Nhị in Vung Tau.
